spec.summary: Implement normalizeTags(input) in tags.mjs to return trimmed, lowercase, non-empty string tags, deduplicated after normalization while preserving first-occurrence order and ignoring non-string values.
criteria: String values are trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace.
Trimmed empty strings are excluded.
Non-string input values are ignored.
Remaining tags are converted to lowercase using JavaScript toLowerCase().
Duplicate tags after lowercasing are removed.
The first occurrence of each normalized tag determines its output position.
Input order is preserved for distinct normalized tags.
normalizeTags is exported from tags.mjs and returns the normalized tag list.
